g.text: Each cell = mean of daily means for one depth and month; blank cells = no sensor data that month
Monthly mean water temperature by sensor depth, Birchy Head, Nova Scotia (2018–2025)
Every year the 2 m water warms from about 2 °C in winter to 18 °C in September, while at 40 m the seasonal swing is damped (2–9 °C) and peaks later, in October.
Data: CMAR Coastal Monitoring Program, station Birchy Head (Open Government Licence – Nova Scotia).
